Photon.label: Photon
Photon.description: Carrier particles of the electromagnetic interaction

Radio.label: Radio
Radio.description: Photon with a wavelength longer than 10 mm (or ν<30 GHz)

Millimeter.label: Millimeter
Millimeter.description: Photon with a wavelength between 0.1 mm and 10 mm (or 30 GHz<=ν<300 GHz)

Infrared.label: Infrared
Infrared.description: Photon with a wavelength between 1 µm and 100 µm

Optical.label: Optical
Optical.description: Photon with a wavelength between 300 nm and 1000 nm

UV.label: Ultraviolet
UV.description: Photon with a wavelength between 100 nm and 300 nm

EUV.label: Extreme UV
EUV.description: Photon with an energy between 12 eV and 120 eV

X-ray.label: X-Ray
X-ray.description: Photon with an energy between 120 eV and 120 keV

Gamma-ray.label: Gamma Ray
Gamma-ray.description: Photon with an energy above 120 keV

Neutrino.label: Neutrino
Neutrino.description: This term comprises all generations of neutrinos (electron, µ, τ), and particles as well as antiparticles.
